heading: LGRA.5.2 / LGRA.16.5 — schema TTL duration
text:
### LGRA.5.2 / LGRA.16.5 — schema TTL duration [LDTL.5.2]

Overlays [LGRA.5.2] (schema_lifecycle `ttl <time_expr>`) and [LGRA.16.5]
(per-emit override via `retain: <DUR>`).

In the default, the `retain:` kwarg on `emit` is restricted
per [LDTL.3.2], and a `publish` takes none ([LTIE.4.9]).  [LGRA.16.5]'s note that "per-emit override remains
available via `emit X retain: <DUR>`" is conditioned on `dynamic_ttl`
being declared.
